incidents.name: ULME token transfer access control
incidents.notes: The ULME token let an unauthorised caller move other holders' balances, so the attacker swept 101 holder addresses into the ULME/BUSD pair inside one flash-loan-funded transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: ULME 0xAE975a25646E6eB859615d0A147B909c13D31FEd created 2022-10-19T14:46:13Z by 0x4a005e5e40ce2b827c873ca37af77e6873e37203, unrelated to attack sender 0x056c20ab7e25e4dd7e49568f964d98e415da63d3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (ULME_exp and ULME_exp2) for this same incident; one row is recorded. lossUsd uses the ~$250k reported drained (the attacker's net profit after the frontrun was ~$50k); onchain, 200,170.83 USDT moved into the ULME/BUSD pair 0xf18e5EC98541D073dAA0864232B9398fa183e0d4 from holder addresses in this transaction.
